FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS) (SHAH ALAM

EXPRESSWAY) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2013

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of the Federal Roads (Private

Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Private Management)

(Collection of Tolls) (Shah Alam Expressway) (Amendment) Order 2013.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 15 January 2013.

Amendment of paragraph 2

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls) (Shah Alam

Expressway) Order 1999 [P.U. (A) 69/1999], which is referred to as the "principal

Order" in this Order, is amended in subparagraph 2(1)—

(a) by substituting for the words "column (2) of Parts I to III of the First

Schedule" the words "column (2) of Parts I to IV of the First Schedule"; and

(b) by substituting for the words "column (1) of Parts I to III" the words "column

(1) of part I to IV".

Amendment of First Schedule

3. The principle Order is amended by substituting for the First Schedule the

following Schedule:
